I updated `design/feature_descriptions/F_448_add_legend_item_dialog_wrong.md` with Current state, Implementation details and Acceptance criteria, and set `status: ready for implementation`. Nothing staged or committed.

**Your answers, now in the doc:**
- **Add-only dialog.** The dialog no longer shows existing entries or the "Include used types" checkbox. Its title becomes "Add legend entry". Bottom-right buttons are Cancel and Add, and a successful Add closes the dialog. The old entry-row component `DiagramLegendEntryEditor` gets deleted, since this dialog was its only user.
- **Picker lists every type**, including ones already in the legend. Picking one already there shows the existing "already has a legend entry" message and the dialog stays open.
- **Ribbon "Legend" button stays** and opens the same add dialog. Its tooltip becomes "Add legend entry".
- **Reorder moves to the legend panel.** In edit mode (New tab or creation session), each row gets a drag handle in front of the item, built with `@dnd-kit/sortable`, which the app already uses. If the legend is still derived (built from diagram types, not stored yet), it is first converted to a stored legend before the move. Otherwise `moveLegendEntry` throws.
- **Out of scope:** more than one legend entry of the same type. The legend file format has no entry ID, so each entry is identified by its type (e.g. `node:focal`). Allowing duplicates means adding an ID and changing all the legend editing code, so it goes in a separate card as you chose.

**Two calls I made that you didn't specify:**
- The drag handle also works from the keyboard (space, arrow keys, space). That makes it accessible and testable without simulating mouse drags. The existing sortable lists in the app only use mouse/pointer dragging.
- The dialog keeps its note explaining that adding an entry to a derived legend keeps the derived entries.
